ai_summary: Kwai runs its own YCNN inference engine (libykit.so, 3103 exported symbols, 1228 ycnn::/ycnn_net::) for face detect/landmarks/matting/segmentation/scene-class/saliency, feeding a GL renderer (libFaceMagic + libskwai + libgorgeous + libwesteros) that performs AR effects and a fully shader-defined beauty chain (skin smoothing, Hald 3D-LUT, luma unsharp mask). A separate analyzer (libvisionengine.so, KVE) drives smart edit/auto-cut via scene-change, motion, quality and highlight DAGs. TensorFlow Lite 2.4.1 is bundled but used only by libykit_module.so (generative AI edit, .fbm models) and the audio library. The APK ships ZERO model files: all networks are downloaded as Kuaishou resource packs (model_matting_v1, effects_like_motion, voice_detect_mode, /rest/o/production/ycnn/models) into app-private dirs (e.g. /Ycnn/modelA, /.magic_model/magic_model) and passed to native code as filesystem paths.

features.name: Camera face detection + landmarks
pipeline: VideoFrame NV21 from libwesteros capture pipeline
YCNNModelIn{data_0=NV21, width, height, colorType=3, faces=[crop rects]}
ycnn::YCNNCropDataMatrix (color convert/crop/scale) -> ycnn_net NEON fp16 / OpenCL / MTK APU
ycnn::YCNNModel::getLandmarks -> KSFaceDetectOut{faces[]: rect, confidence, yaw/pitch/roll, pos[K](x,y,z,valid)}
callbacks to Westeros plugins (salient / general-recog / face-attribute)
features.notes: Weights are downloaded; FaceDetectorContext.ModelMissingListener.onModelMissing(int,String) exists precisely for the absent-model case. Network input resolution and landmark count come from the .model header (net_w/net_h) and are NOT recoverable from the APK.

features.name: Beauty / skin smoothing + LUT grading
pipeline: YUV -> RGB (GLSL yuv2rgb, BT.601/709/2020 coefficient sets)
pass-1 fragment shader: 5-tap mean (sum*0.2) + high-frequency energy diff=min(((i-mean)*7)^2,1), alpha=(r+g+b)*0.33
pass-2: 3x3 box blur (sum*0.1111) of mean and variance
sharpen(): luma unsharp high=(Yori-Ylow)*(1-base.x^2)*sharpness added back in YUV
features.notes: All GLSL is plain rodata in libgorgeous.so (offsets 0x12f75d, 0x12fc3d, 0x1312c8, 0x1319be, 0x12fef8 plus the spliced lookUp/sharpen strings). Fully reimplemented in JAX.

features.name: AR effects / virtual face (stickers, makeup, 3D mesh)
pipeline: effect pack (index file + assetsDir) from westeros resource manager
Gorgeous makeup (FMGorgeousMakeup), 3D effects (FM3DEffect), bokeh depth (FMBokehDepthEffect), white skin (FMWhiteSKinEffect), hair dyeing/softening
SKwai GL/Lua scene graph renders result texture
features.notes: Renderer consumes landmarks/masks from YCNN; no NN inside libskwai.so (0 JNI, pure C++ API) or libFaceMagic.so.

features.name: Smart edit / auto-cut (KVE analysis)
pipeline: scene_change_analysis_dag_, motion_analysis_dag, face_score_dag, face_laplacian_dag, focus_center_dag, homo_proc_dag, complexity_dag_
features.notes: No TfLite imports and no ycnn strings in libvisionengine.so; the DAGs appear to be hand-crafted CV metrics plus scene labels supplied from the YcnnPlugin general-recog stream. Scene classification itself is a YCNN model (KSModelGeneralRecog01 / YCNNModelSceneClass=7).

features.name: Generative AI edit (segmentation-driven)
features.notes: Only consumer of libtensorflow-lite.so besides libksaudioprocesslib-dl.so; no .fbm/.tflite payload in the APK.

features.name: Upload bitrate estimation
features.notes: Called a 'model' in the API but it is a bitrate predictor, not a neural network (no TFLite/YCNN linkage).

reimplementation.limitations: Beauty stages (5-tap mean/variance pass, kMin skin smoothing, Hald 3D LUT, luma unsharp mask) and the NV21 preprocessing path are transcribed exactly from libgorgeous GLSL/rodata and numerically verified (JAX vs numpy parity max_abs_err=0; LUT identity delta 3.2e-07; NV21 round trip 36.43 dB PSNR) - these parts are real. Face detection / landmarks / matting are ARCHITECTURE_ONLY: the YCNN .model weights and graphs are not in the APK (downloaded resource packs), so ycnn_contract.py runs a placeholder head with random weights; only the I/O contract (struct layouts, 35 model-type ids, KSLandmarksParam defaults, NV21 crop semantics) is real. TFLite models referenced by the AI-edit plugin are likewise absent.

VideoFrame.yuv_format {0=I420,1=NV12,2=NV21,3=RGBA} -> YCNN KSY_COLOR_TYPE {0=BGRA,1=RGBA,2=NV12,3=NV21,4=YUV420P,5=Y,6=YUVA444} mapping: performed inside the native AndroidVideoFrame wrapper in libdaenerys.so, not readable from the APK.

data_pipelines.name: Camera2 frame -> packed YUV -> YCNN face detect / landmarks

trigger.detail: ImageReader.OnImageAvailableListener (Camera2 via Huawei CameraKit) delivers preview frames; legacy fallback to android.hardware.Camera1

transport.format: packed YUV420 (I420|NV12|NV21) in a direct ByteBuffer, or GL texture (2D/OES) or Bitmap
transport.stride: de-strided to stride==width by videoCapture.i.f(); mismatched buffer size recreates the FrameBuffer pool
transport.timestamp: long ms (TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS.toMillis), plus raw sensor timestamp in attributes

steps: de-interleave Image planes (Y + VU / UV / U,V) and de-stride row-wise
engine-side colour convert + crop + resize in ycnn::YCNNCropDataMatrix
preprocessing.normalisation_constants: unknown (no mean/std constants in libykit.so rodata; only a scalar doNormalize(double))

model_invocation.engine: YCNN (ycnn::YCNNModel / ycnn_net NEON fp16, OpenCL, MTK APU)
model_invocation.binding: kuaishou::VideoRawFrame(MediaDataType, PixelbufferType, shared_ptr<void>, w, h, ts, VideoFrameAttributes&) for CPU frames; VideoRawFrame(MediaDataType, shared_ptr<render::gl::Texture>, w, h, ts, attrs) for textures; YCNNModelIn.data_0 = byte[] (NV21 default, colorType=3)

postprocessing.coordinate_space: detector returns coordinates in the pre-rotation buffer space; YCNNModelIn.rotate/flipHor and normOut/normRotate/normFlipHor/normFlipVer select the transform applied by the engine; renderer applies the same Transform stored on the frame; points_stabilizer.cpp + estimateRigidTransform provide temporal smoothing (parameters unknown)
